analysis_steps.goal: Align and combine the three epochs and image

method.value: Fit 2D Gaussian to star with imfit, phase-shift with fixvis, concat the three datasets, image with tclean natural weighting

evidence.quote: Each dataset was then phase-shifted using the task `fixvis` so that the pointing center of the data was the same as the fitted star position.

method.value: Extract surface brightness and fit 1D Gaussians to vertical slices along the major axis; subtract beam FWHM in quadrature

evidence.quote: Broadening effects of the synthesized beam in the vertical direction have been removed by subtracting in quadrature the Gaussian beam FWHM

analysis_steps.goal: Fit parametric disk model to visibilities

method.value: Ray-traced axisymmetric optically thin disk with Gaussian vertical profile and H=hr, power-law surface density; model image Fourier transformed and sampled with uvmodel; MCMC fit

evidence.quote: it is Fourier transformed into the visibility domain and sampled at the same spatial frequencies as the ALMA data with the `MIRIAD` task `uvmodel`.
All runs used 50 walkers, and $10^5$ samples were drawn from each run

assumptions.value: opacity 2.3 cm^2/g; dust in blackbody equilibrium; L*=0.09 Lsun; d=9.725 pc; vertically isothermal

evidence.quote: we assume that the dust grains are in blackbody equilibrium with the central star

fitting.value: Affine-invariant emcee, lnL=-chi^2/2, uniform priors (log-uniform for dust mass); 10 free parameters

evidence.quote: We assume uniform priors for all parameters.

validation.value: Skinny model with h=0.003 fit worse (3.7σ AICc, ΔBIC 5.8); inclination bound test; reduced chi2 1.032

evidence.quote: The skinny model results in a significantly poorer fit to the data than the fiducial model

method.value: Add gap or ring component; compare via AICc and BIC

evidence.quote: We use both the AICc, a form of the Aikake Information Criterion (AIC) corrected for finite datasets, and the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC)
the ring width was fixed to 0.1 au

validation.value: Ring preferred at 3.7σ by AICc but fiducial preferred on BIC (ΔBIC=4.3)

evidence.quote: the fiducial model is preferred to the ring model on the BIC with $\Delta \text{BIC} = 4.3$

method.value: Convert h to inclination dispersion and relative velocity; set lower limit on body size from escape velocity; steady-state Pan & Schlichting model gives sqrt(Np)*mp

findings_qualitative.value: Disk vertical structure is resolved; AU Mic has the narrowest mm scale height of any known debris disk

evidence.quote: to our knowledge, AU Mic exhibits the narrowest millimeter-wavelength scale height of any known debris disk.

findings_qualitative.value: Marginal evidence for an inner dust ring at ~10 au

evidence.quote: the data are suggestive of an additional ring of dust at $\sim \SI{10}{au}$

claims.hypothesis: Is the mm vertical thickness of the AU Mic disk resolved rather than an upper limit?
claims.experiment: MCMC visibility modeling and comparison with a thin h=0.003 model
claims.result: h=0.031 (+0.005/-0.004), ~8σ; skinny model disfavored at 3.7σ AICc
claims.finding: Scale height is measured, not an upper limit

evidence.quote: which translates to a $\sim 8 \sigma$ measurement of the scale height rather than an upper limit

claims.experiment: Relate h to velocity dispersion and steady-state collisional model
claims.result: Stirring bodies >~400 km; largest body <~1.8 Earth masses
claims.finding: Rules out gas giant or Neptune analog embedded in outer disk

evidence.quote: These measurements rule out the presence of a gas giant or Neptune analog near the $\sim \SI{40}{au}$ outer edge of the debris ring

claims.hypothesis: Is there an additional inner ring?
claims.experiment: Add ring/gap to model, compare AICc/BIC
claims.result: AICc prefers ring (3.7σ), BIC prefers fiducial

evidence.quote: we are not able to conclusively confirm the presence of an additional ring of mm dust grains in the AU Mic disk.

claims.hypothesis: Does gas affect the dust kinematics?
claims.finding: Gas does not influence mm grain scale height

evidence.quote: this CO mass corresponds to an upper limit of $\sim 1$ on the gas-to-dust ratio.

why_this_method.value: Parametric modeling to handle degeneracy between vertical structure, radial structure, and viewing geometry

evidence.quote: we adopt a modeling approach that combines a simple ray-tracing code to properly project the radial and vertical flux distribution

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Gap model rejected: gap converged to regions with zero density

evidence.quote: we take this as evidence that the data are not well characterized by a gap

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Single stellar flux across dates rejected (7.3σ AICc)

evidence.quote: did not reproduce the data to the same degree of accuracy as the fiducial model

evidence.quote: if the phase noise is at the upper end of the range suggested by the quasar measurements, it may be an upper limit instead.

limitations_admitted.value: External perturbers not considered; limits on embedded perturbers are then upper limits
